checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan: scaffold, deterministic beam engine + solver/tests, then UI shell, gameplay UI, menus/polish, multi-model review and gates

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for a new game with a UI that six independent model providers will review; a deterministic browser puzzle with a pure engine makes both gameplay and visual QA reproducible.
impact_assessment.benefits: Zero-install static game; testable beam physics and level solvability; a committed UI contract and screenshot evidence for reviewers.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: engine/UI boundary and level format; dependency: none allowed beyond Node stdlib and browser APIs; concurrency: animation frames versus input state; state: progress persistence versioning.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Pure modules for rules, a solver-backed test for every level, a single state owner, versioned localStorage, and UI guard + screenshot passes before commit.

handoff.next: scaffold package.json, level data, engine, solver, tests

checkpoints.description: [2/5] Engine, six solver-backed chambers, progress module, UI shell, UI contract and screenshot-ready inventory; checklists: passed

handoff.next: ui begin, implement final gameplay renderer and visual system
